title: Hale API v1 — DNA reads, drafts and the head's commands
description: Implemented read contract, drafts and the project service head. The record's commands, Knowledge changes included, are the head's api binding, described by `hale describe <socket>`, not this schema.

Practice.description: Named Practice catalog row; exact id lookup also returns recognized unnamed Knowledge and retirement candidates using the same canonical receipt and visibility validation. Generic exact candidates do not enter the named Practice list.

read_only.description: Always true: HTTP writes nothing itself. Every command is a topic on the head's api binding, reached over HTTP through the forwarding route at `api.http`; what this session may send is its describe slice.

api.description: Where the record's commands are: the head's api binding. Its contract is `hale describe <socket>`; the socket is empty when no head serves this listener; `http` is the forwarding route for the browser.

http.description: The route that forwards one line of the same wire per POST to that socket, marked `via: http-session` (GH #1135); empty when the session cannot be forwarded (OIDC).

KnowledgeInt64.description: Canonical signed Int64 decimal string, exactly -9223372036854775808 through 9223372036854775807. Validators must assert int64-decimal format.

Usage.description: Model calls summed from their model.called evidence rows: an attempt's own, or a task's with every task under it, by position (the graph's position id) and by backend/model. Counters are native integers as decimal strings.

KnowledgeBindingCandidateDocument.description: The native reader validates digest syntax, exact canonical bytes/hash, tuple identity, captured grant and originating Record request; schema checks the closed document shape.

anyOf.description: Exact canonical JSON string; parse only according to its explicit binding or edge discriminator. Native reader verifies document hash and originating admitted command/grant, independently of graph projection.

candidate_commit.description: Exact lowercase native Git object identity validated by the reader.

anyOf.description: document is the literal JSON OrganizationSourceCandidateDocument read. A separately configured Organization recovery grant is required; it does not enable publishing.

KnowledgeEdgeCandidateDocument.description: Exact native canonical document, fourteen fields. Native reader validates digest, tuple, captured grant, Record author/application, endpoint visibility and historical tuple basis.

source_head.description: Exact lowercase native Git object identity validated by the reader.

module_digest.description: Exact sha256 digest syntax and bytes verified by the native reader.

digest.description: Exact sha256 digest syntax and bytes verified by the native reader.

commit.description: Exact lowercase native Git object identity validated by the reader.

parent.description: Exact lowercase native Git object identity validated by the reader.

receipt_digest.description: Exact sha256 digest syntax and bytes verified by the native reader.

digest.description: Exact sha256 digest syntax and bytes verified by the native reader.

verification.description: receipt_digest authenticates the retained native diff JSON; digest authenticates the distinct returned OrganizationSemanticDiff projection document. They are not interchangeable.

OrganizationSourceCandidateDocument.description: Immutable evidence assembled from the original admitted native request and retained Git objects. Module strings are exact UTF-8 bytes bounded to 16384 natively; each retained diff is bounded to 131072 bytes and verified by SHA256. Git commit identity is distinct from module digest. This is a read document, not a native publication or activation receipt.

OrganizationSemanticDiff.description: Deliberately selected native semantic read: classification, exact summary counts and declaration identity/change only. It omits compiler locations and raw contracts, effects, law details and diagnostics; counts do not provide those omitted details.

OrganizationImpactCounts.description: Canonical unsigned decimal strings. Runtime invariants: open_workflow_tasks <= workflow_tasks; open_legacy_tasks <= legacy_tasks; handed_tasks <= open_legacy_tasks. These cross-field comparisons are checked by the native projection and consumer, not expressed by this JSON Schema subset.

OrganizationSourceImpact.description: Exact source Review at one current Record head. Counts cover the whole application, with no inferred position binding or admission fence. none_observed does not authorize publication or establish that no live responsibility exists outside this read profile.

assignment_digest.description: Exact native sha256 digest of ordered relevant Task lifecycle facts; syntax and native history are verified by the owning reader.

assignee.description: Exact requested current recorded assignee, echoed only when filtered; not owner or position membership.

Hat.description: The hat (GH #946): one Work's context as structure, never a prompt. A point-in-time render fenced to the Record head and memory's projection watermark; the digest is sha256 over the canonical body with the digest itself left out, and is what an attempt, a receipt and a tape key on. Positions are the graph's position:<name> ids.

HeadOperationName.description: The closed set of head operations; every one is version 1 and is the CLI verb, run detached by the head.

active.description: The attached project's application_id, or empty when detached.

HeadIdentity.description: Who answered: the head profile, the trusted-local principal every command runs as, and the active project. Not a Record source: head routes carry no record_id.

HeadEnvelope.description: The envelope of the four head routes. A Record envelope's source object is not permitted here.

HeadBody.description: The local body as the head sees it: its own child, or `external` when `<root>/.hale/dna/org.pid` is alive and not a head child.

HeadCredentials.description: Names only: the credentials the catalog names, the operator's file sources, and the needed names set in the head's environment. No value ever crosses this wire.

busy.description: The command_id of the running receipt, or empty.

HeadAuthority.description: Whether each per-project policy file is present and decodes for this identity under the Record's trust.

HeadProject.description: One registered project. The five detail fields (authority, connections, handoffs, secrets, receipts) are present only on the `?id=` read; the projections are read in-process from the Record and touch no network.

SecretSource.description: Where the run script reads a secret: a 0600 one-line file under the operator's sources directory, or an environment variable the shell reads. The head never reads the value.

HeadCommandArguments.description: The closed superset of every operation's arguments; each operation admits only its own keys (the allowlists of the head README), and a `value` key is never one of them.

application_id.description: The attached project's application_id; empty only for dna.project.create, init, attach and forget.

principal.description: Untrusted expected identity, compared with the head's principal before anything is recorded; never grants authority.

HeadCommandRequest.description: One head command (dna.head-command/1). The head validates the shape before recording; a shape error is 400 invalid_command, never a receipt.

HeadRun.description: How the command executed: a detached run, the long-lived body child, or inline in the POST. `external` says whether a deadline yields outcome_unknown (true) or failed.

HeadCommandReceipt.description: The fold of the receipt journal for one command: recorded, then admitted or refused, then running, then succeeded, failed or outcome_unknown. A deadline on an external verb is outcome_unknown with evidence, never failed.
